3.title: CBT - Cognitive Restructuring
3.goal: Techniques for identifying and challenging negative thought patterns to alter emotional responses and behaviors. Focuses on examining evidence, reattributing blame, and considering alternative perspectives.
keyConcepts: Identifying Cognitive Distortions: recognizing patterns like all-or-nothing thinking, catastrophizing, and overgeneralization
Examine the evidence for and against your thoughts to develop a more balanced perspective.
Substitute distorted thoughts with healthier, more realistic alternatives that support well-being.

books.title: CBT - Cognitive Restructuring (Challenging Thoughts)
books.summary: A practical guide to cognitive restructuring techniques, including exercises and real-life applications.

3.title: Parenting a Child with Emotional or Behavioral Disorder
3.goal: To equip parents, teachers, and counselors with practical tools and understanding to effectively support and nurture children with emotional or behavioral disorders in home and school settings.
keyConcepts: Consistent Structure and Routines: Creating a predictable environment helps children feel secure and reduces anxiety.
Collaborative Support Systems: Involving parents, teachers, and mental health professionals to create a network of support.
Positive Behavior Reinforcement: Encouraging desired behaviors through praise and rewards, rather than focusing solely on negative behaviors.

books.title: Parenting a Child with Emotional or Behavioral Disorder
books.author: Mary M. Wood
books.summary: This book provides practical strategies and compassionate guidance to help caregivers and educators support children with emotional or behavioral disorders through consistent structure, collaboration, and positive reinforcement.

3.goal: To help teenagers understand and apply Cognitive Behavioral Therapy techniques to manage anxiety, stress, and negative thinking patterns in daily life.

books.author: Lisa M. Schab, LCSW
books.title: CBT Workbook for Teens: Exercises to Help You Deal with Anxiety, Stress, and Worry
books.summary: A practical guide to CBT techniques for teens, including exercises and real-life applications.

3.title: Judgment Containment
3.goal: To help parents and caregivers support a teen whose difficulty with a task turns into harsh self-judgment, responding with understanding and choice while staying aware of the expectations their own words and presence may communicate.
keyConcepts: Separate the event from the verdict: a specific difficulty does not establish a conclusion about your teen's character or future.
Notice and gently check shifts from one event to everything, from now to forever, or from difficulty to identity.
Examine your own assumptions, comparisons, tone, and presence, and offer a small choice of support.

books.title: Judgment Containment
books.author: Pulse Parenting
books.summary: A practical manual for parents and caregivers on supporting a teen through painful self-judgment with understanding, choice, and awareness of the expectations their words and unspoken responses may communicate.

3.title: Positive Trajectory Building
3.goal: To help parents and caregivers create small, chosen experiences that let a teen approach difficulty, ask for support, adapt, pause, return, and build self-trust.
keyConcepts: Recognize agency beyond completion: noticing, choosing support, adapting, pausing, returning, and repairing all count.
Make recognition specific, proportionate, and chosen rather than evaluative or pressuring.
Use MEET (meaning, environment, entry, terms) to design one workable encounter with an agreed ending.

books.title: Positive Trajectory Building
books.author: Pulse Parenting
books.summary: A practical manual for parents and caregivers on creating small, chosen experiences of agency, competence, connection, and recovery for a teen facing task friction and recurring self-judgment.
